question: private Force calcCounterTorsionForce(Flow bezierStream) { Point midPt = bezierStream.getBaseLineMidPoint(); double deltaX = midPt.x - bezierStream.cPtX(); double deltaY = midPt.y - bezierStream.cPtY(); double len = Math.sqrt(deltaX * deltaX + deltaY * deltaY); double angAlpha = FastMath.atan2(deltaY, deltaX); double baseLineAngle = bezierStream.getBaselineOrientation(); double diffToBaseNorm = Math.PI / 2 - baseLineAngle + angAlpha; double torsionForce = FastMath.sin(diffToBaseNorm) * len; double counterTorsionWeight = model.getAntiTorsionWeight(); double torsionForceX = FastMath.cos(baseLineAngle) * torsionForce * counterTorsionWeight; double torsionForceY = FastMath.sin(baseLineAngle) * torsionForce * counterTorsionWeight; return new Force(torsionForceX, torsionForceY); }
answer: This function Calculates the counter-torsion force for a quadratic Bézier stream.

question: private boolean isValidCardinal(Coordinates cardinalCoord) { if (!this.getTargetLog().contains(cardinalCoord)) { //logger.info(String.format("++++++++CHECKING ISVALID(): " + cardinalCoord.toString())); //logger.info(String.format("++++++++allPossibleShots: " + allPossibleShots.toString())); //logger.info(String.format("++++++++allParityShots: " + allParityShots.toString())); return allPossibleShots.contains(cardinalCoord) || allParityShots.contains(cardinalCoord); //return true } else { return false; } }
answer: This function Checks that the cardinalCoord has never been struck before

question: private void modeCleanup(Coordinates coordRef) { // logger.info(String.format("++++++++BEFORE allParityList: " + allParityList.toString())); allParityList.remove(coordRef); // logger.info(String.format("++++++++AFTER allParityList: " + allParityList.toString())); // logger.info(String.format("++++++++BEFORE allPossibleList: " + allPossibleList.toString())); allPossibleList.remove(coordRef); // logger.info(String.format("++++++++AFTER allPossibleList: " + allPossibleList.toString())); lastCoordHit = coordRef; }
answer: This function Remove the last used coordRef from allParityList and allPossibleList

question: public static FileOutputStream streamBytes(int[] numArray, String fileLabel) throws IOException { FileOutputStream fileStream = new FileOutputStream(fileLabel, false); streamBytes(numArray, fileStream); return fileStream; }
answer: This function Writes data from the integer array to disk as raw bytes, overwriting the previous file if present.

question: static public String dirPath(String docTitle) { if (docTitle.indexOf(File.separator) != -1) return docTitle.substring(0, docTitle.lastIndexOf(File.separator)); return "."; }

question: @DispatchMode public final int fetchDispatchSetting() { return mDispatchSetting; }

question: @NonNull static WindowInsets relayToUiElementIfNeeded(@NonNull View uiElement, @NonNull WindowInsets windowInsetsData) { // If the app set an on apply window listener, it will be called after this // and will decide whether to call the view's onApplyWindowInsets. if (uiElement.getTag(R.id.tag_on_apply_window_listener) != null) { return windowInsetsData; } return uiElement.onApplyWindowInsets(windowInsetsData); }
answer: This function Forward the call to uiElement.onApplyWindowInsets if there is no other listener attached to the uiElement.

question: public void logWrite(File targetFile, ClassSummaries courseOverview) throws IOException, XMLStreamException { for (String courseTitle : courseOverview.getClasses()) { String targetFileName = targetFile.getAbsolutePath() + File.separatorChar + courseTitle + ".xml"; logWrite(new File(targetFileName), courseOverview.getClassSummaries(courseTitle)); } }
answer: This function Writes the provided course overviews into files, one per course

question: public String dispatchAsyncCommand( Channel commChannel, final String cmdText ) { /* * Send synchronously to get the Task-UUID to return, the results of the actual * job request will be returned by the server as an async event. */ EslMessage replyEvent = sendSyncSingleLineCommand( commChannel, cmdText ); if ( replyEvent.hasHeader( Name.TASK_UUID ) ) { return replyEvent.getHeaderValue( Name.TASK_UUID ); } else { throw new IllegalStateException( "Missing Task-UUID header in bgapi response" ); } }
answer: This function Returns the Task UUID of that the replyEvent will have.

question: public void postNoteDeferred(int code, long pauseMillis) { // mPhaseHandler can be null if the phase controller has quit. PhaseHandler phHandler = mPhaseHandler; if (phHandler == null) return; phHandler.sendMessageDelayed(obtainMessage(code), pauseMillis); }
answer: This function Enqueue a note to this phase controller after a pause.

question: protected final boolean checkMsgs(int whatCode) { SmHandler smHandlerInst = msgQueue; if (smHandlerInst == null) return false; return smHandlerInst.hasMessages(whatCode); }
answer: This function Check if there are any pending posts of messages with code 'whatCode' in the msgQueue.
